maddeler.e:
تفاعلت (form VI)
# تَفَاعَلْتُ (tafāʕaltu) /ta.faː.ʕal.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَفَاعَلَ (tafāʕala)
# تَفَاعَلْتَ (tafāʕalta) /ta.faː.ʕal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَفَاعَلَ (tafāʕala)
# تَفَاعَلْتِ (tafāʕalti) /ta.faː.ʕal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَفَاعَلَ (tafāʕala)
# تَفَاعَلَتْ (tafāʕalat) /ta.faː.ʕa.lat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
